summary: Go leader-first, not institution-first: free-tier/pilot offers, hands-on onboarding, and champion-sourcing to individual pastors and small-group leaders are the best-supported tactics, while defer campus-ministry coalitions and diocese-style institutional partnerships until that leader-first motion is proven -- no faith-specific leader-first precedent exists, so the strategy remains a cross-domain hypothesis, and the original 'relational outperforms digital' claim for campus ministry was corrected to a softer complementary framing.
